notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Delif's Cone.
Cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Sky Hussar.
When Sky Hussar enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.
